mapper.select: select count(1) from dms_registration dr left join sms_skd skd on dr.skd_id = skd.id where dr.id = #{registrationId} and skd.staff_id = #{staffId}

select p.id as patientId,p.name as name,p.gender as gender,TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.date_of_birth, dr.attendance_date) as age from dms_registration dr left join pms_patient p on dr.patient_id = p.id where dr.id = #{registrationId} limit 1
